title: Consumer Protection Act 1995 (No. 2 of 1995)
citation: Consumer Protection Act 1995 (No. 2 of 1995), passed 6 March 1995, assented 29 March 1995
notes: Scanned PDF from the Parliament Acts list (year 1995), read by OCR on 2026-11-09. Section 1 leaves commencement to a date the Minister appoints by Gazette notice; none found, so in_force is null. Section 24: "No trader or person shall, in the course of a trade or business, engage in conduct that is misleading or deceptive or is likely to mislead or deceive." Section 25 makes false representations about the standard, quality, approval or benefits of goods or services an offence. Neither names environmental or climate claims; the Act is the general umbrella for them. Link only: row SB-PARLIAMENT-ADOPTED is permission requested. English only; no government translation exists to look for.
